entities.summary: Equatorial Guinea is a sovereign nation in Central Africa, Africa. Its capital is Malabo (current), Ciudad de la Paz (planned new capital on mainland). Official languages include Spanish, French, Portuguese. Government: Unitary dominant-party presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 1.8 million. Area: 28,051 km². Comprehensive index for Equatorial Guinea covering Bubi and Fang peoples, Portuguese discovery, Spanish colonial period (Fernando Pó and Río Muni), independence 1968, Macías Nguema's reign of terror, Obiang Nguema (world's longest-ruling non-royal head of state), and oil wealth/corruption.
